name: carbone-mcp-server
title: Carbone
summary: Generate PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents from templates and JSON data, and convert files between 36 formats, with the official Carbone MCP server.
description: The official Carbone MCP server lets AI agents automate document generation and file conversion. Fill DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, HTML or Markdown templates with JSON data, or fill existing PDF forms, to produce invoices, contracts, reports, quotes and certificates as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more. Convert files between 36 formats: DOCX to PDF, HTML to PDF, Markdown to PDF, XLSX to CSV and others. Ask which data a template expects, then manage a versioned template library: upload, categorize, tag, deploy and download templates. Finish PDFs with passwords, watermarks, PDF/A and page ranges, generate up to 100 documents per batch delivered to a webhook, and localize output with translations, time zones and currency conversion. The hosted server at https://mcp.carbone.io signs you in with your Carbone account over OAuth 2.1. You can also self-host it with npx or Docker, against Carbone Cloud or Carbone On-premise. Open source (Apache-2.0). Free account at https://account.carbone.io.

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your Carbone API key, free at https://account.carbone.io. stdio: required for Carbone Cloud. HTTP: optional, leave it unset so each client sends its own Authorization: Bearer key; when set, requests without a key spend it. With Carbone On-premise, set your instance's token when its authentication is enabled, or leave it empty otherwise.

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Carbone API base URL. Keep the default for Carbone Cloud, or set the URL of your Carbone On-premise instance.

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_TIMEOUT
environment_variables.description: Timeout of each Carbone API request, in milliseconds. Carbone Cloud's synchronous API has its own 60-second limit.

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_MAX_FILE_BYTES
environment_variables.description: Largest input file the server accepts from a local path, URL or base64 string, in bytes (default 100 MB).

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
environment_variables.description: Set to true to let URL inputs resolve to private and internal addresses. Off by default to block SSRF; enable it only on a trusted deployment with internal template hosts.

environment_variables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: stdio for local MCP clients, or http to run a Streamable HTTP server. The Docker image sets http.

environment_variables.name: MCP_PATH
environment_variables.description: HTTP only. MCP endpoint path. Must start with / and cannot be /health (reserved for the health check).

environment_variables.name: MCP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environment_variables.description: Largest incoming MCP message in bytes (default 60 MB, Carbone Cloud's JSON data limit). Larger HTTP requests get 413.

environment_variables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environment_variables.description: HTTP only. Comma-separated browser Origin hostnames allowed in addition to localhost, without scheme or port (e.g. app.example.com). Other origins get 403.

environment_variables.name: CARBONE_REQUIRE_CLIENT_AUTH_HEADER
environment_variables.description: HTTP only. Set to true to require Authorization: Bearer on every request instead of falling back to the server-level CARBONE_API_KEY. Recommended when CARBONE_API_KEY is set on a shared server.

useCases.name: Invoice and financial report generation
useCases.description: Automatically generate branded PDF or DOCX invoices and financial reports by combining your billing data with a reusable template. Line items, totals, taxes, and currency formatting are resolved automatically — no manual editing required.

useCases.name: Legal contract drafting
useCases.description: Produce ready-to-sign PDF or Word contracts at scale by merging party details, dates, and custom clauses into a standard contract template. Each document is uniquely personalised while maintaining a consistent, professional layout.

useCases.name: HR and onboarding documents
useCases.description: Generate personalised offer letters, onboarding packs, and payslips for every employee by combining HR records with a shared template. Supports PDF, DOCX, and ODT output, making it easy to integrate into any HR workflow.

useCases.name: Multi-language document export
useCases.description: Deliver documents in any language from a single template by specifying the target locale at generation time. The same invoice, contract, or report can be rendered in French, German, Spanish, or any other language without maintaining separate templates.

useCases.name: Report automation
useCases.description: Turn raw business data into formatted XLSX, ODS, PDF, or HTML reports for finance, operations, or analytics teams. Tables expand automatically based on the data, and number or date formatting is applied consistently across every report.

useCases.name: Document format conversion
useCases.description: Convert any existing document to a different format — DOCX to PDF, HTML to PDF, Markdown to PDF, XLSX to CSV, PPTX to ODP, across 36 formats — without needing a template. Useful for standardising document formats across systems or preparing files for archiving.

useCases.name: Data-driven spreadsheet generation
useCases.description: Generate fully formatted XLSX or ODS spreadsheets from structured data. Rows expand dynamically based on the dataset, making it straightforward to produce financial models, inventory reports, or export files for downstream tools.

useCases.name: Presentation generation
useCases.description: Automatically populate PPTX or ODP slide decks with live data — KPIs, chart labels, and narrative text — from a master template. Ideal for recurring business reviews, client reports, or automated dashboards that need a polished output.

useCases.name: Template management
useCases.description: Maintain a centralised library of document templates — upload new versions, browse available templates, update metadata, and retire outdated ones — keeping the document generation pipeline consistent and up to date across teams.

useCases.name: Bulk document generation
useCases.description: Generate thousands of personalised documents — certificates, statements, contracts — from a single template and a list of records. Each output is uniquely populated with the recipient's data, with no infrastructure to manage beyond the API call.

carboneOAuth2.description: Sign in with your Carbone account. OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE (S256), dynamic client registration and refresh tokens. The doc_rwd scope grants template and document access.
